title: Bulk Email Mail Settings Permission Consistency

items.action: authorize the Bulk Email send action and wizard business flow

migration.reason: All consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

backend.reason: Existing backend authorization and bulk-email sender requirements remain unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes are introduced; the frontend email-account list wrapper fails closed before issuing an unauthorized request.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend resource lookup, query, or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: Operations navigation remains controlled by its existing navigation permission; this contract covers the specialized Bulk Email wizard route and its mail-settings lookups.

route_guard.reason: The specialized /operations/new/bulk-email route requires fair_crm.fair_emails.execute plus the mandatory fair_crm.mail_templates.read and fair_crm.email_accounts.read lookup prerequisites; fair_crm.operations.create is not a Bulk Email prerequisite.

notes: Bulk Email wizard entry requires fair_crm.fair_emails.execute together with fair_crm.mail_templates.read and fair_crm.email_accounts.read because template and sender selection are mandatory to complete the wizard. The Operations-page type picker uses the same composite entry prerequisite. Send itself remains authorized only by fair_crm.fair_emails.execute, preview remains the independent optional fair_crm.fair_emails.preview capability, and fair_crm.operations.create is not a Bulk Email prerequisite. The email-account list client continues to fail closed locally when fair_crm.email_accounts.read is absent.
